changes: A genuine battery configuration invalidation exposes an explicit code to settings UI; popup once until a new test is passed, no popup for phase selection or identical config.
Live settings shows fresh L1/L2/L3 power and configured phase limit; numeric over-limit readings are red. Missing/stale readings show dash and never stale alarms.
passed: changed JavaScript and inline script syntax; JSON parsing
limits: Uses existing UI status refresh cadence; no polling, listener or timer added. UI colour is an indication, not physical electrical protection.
